title: Fix Subscription Method & Add Ad Revenue Monetization

requirements.summary: Fix the broken Stripe premium subscription flow end-to-end, ensuring proper checkout session creation, payment page redirection, success/failure handling, and subscription status updates
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the subscribe/upgrade button on the Upgrade page initiates a Stripe checkout session and redirects to the Stripe payment page
After successful payment, the user is redirected to /payment-success, their subscription status is updated to premium, and a success message is shown
After cancelled/failed payment, the user is redirected to /payment-failure with a retry option
The Settings page correctly displays 'Premium' tier after a successful subscription
The UpgradePrompt component is hidden for users with an active premium subscription
The backend correctly stores and returns subscription status per user principal

file_operations.description: Fix the checkout session hook to properly parse the JSON response from createCheckoutSession, validate that the session includes a non-empty url field, and throw an error if missing. Ensure the mutation returns both id and url from the parsed CheckoutSession type. Verify the Stripe component's usage instructions before implementing.

Fix the checkout flow to properly handle the CheckoutSession result from useCreateCheckoutSession. After successful mutation, validate that session.url exists and is non-empty, then redirect using window.location.href = session.url (not router navigation). Add error handling to display a user-friendly message if session.url is missing or invalid. Never navigate to /undefined.

Fix the payment success page to extract the session_id from URL parameters, call getStripeSessionStatus to verify the payment, then call setSubscriptionStatus with the authenticated user's principal and 'premium' status to upgrade the user. Display loading, error, or success states appropriately. Invalidate subscription status queries after successful upgrade.

Enhance the payment failure page to provide a clear retry option that navigates back to the Upgrade page (/upgrade) so users can attempt the subscription flow again. Ensure the home page button also works correctly.

Review and ensure the subscription status hook correctly fetches the user's tier from the backend at all times, with proper cache invalidation when status changes. Verify it returns an object with tier ('free' or 'premium') and feature flags.

Verify that the Settings page correctly displays the user's subscription tier using useGetUserSubscriptionStatus, showing 'Premium' when the user has an active premium subscription and 'Free' otherwise.

Fix the UpgradePrompt component to check the user's subscription status using useGetUserSubscriptionStatus and hide the component entirely when the user has an active premium subscription. Only show the upgrade prompt to free-tier users.

requirements.summary: Add an ad revenue dashboard UI showing total earnings and per-video breakdown, with automatic ad impression recording after 10 seconds of video playback
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users see a 'Ad Revenue' card/section in their Profile or Settings page
Total earnings are displayed in USD with two decimal places
A per-video table/list shows video title, impression count, and estimated earnings
An ad impression is automatically recorded after 10 seconds of video playback on the VideoPlayer page
Revenue data refreshes when the user navigates to the earnings section
Non-authenticated users do not see the ad revenue section

file_operations.description: Create a React Query hook that fetches the authenticated caller's total ad revenue via actor.getAdRevenueForCaller(). Enable the query only when actor is available and user is authenticated. Return the total revenue as a number.

Create a React Query hook that fetches ad revenue data for a specific video ID via actor.getAdRevenueForVideo(videoId). Return an object containing impressions (bigint) and totalRevenue (number). Enable only when actor is available.

Create a React Query mutation hook that calls actor.recordAdImpression(videoId) to log an ad view. Invalidate ad revenue queries on success. Handle errors gracefully without showing toast notifications to avoid disrupting video playback.

Create a dashboard component that displays total ad earnings using useGetAdRevenueForCaller formatted in USD with two decimal places. Fetch the user's uploaded videos via useVideos filtered by the authenticated user's principal. For each video, fetch ad revenue data using useGetAdRevenueForVideo and display a table/list showing video title, impression count, and estimated earnings. Show loading skeletons while data is fetching. Only render for authenticated users.

Add an 'Ad Revenue' section to the authenticated user's Profile page by rendering the AdRevenueDashboard component below the user info and above or alongside the videos/photos tabs. Ensure it's visible only to the profile owner (authenticated user viewing their own profile).

Add logic to automatically record an ad impression after 10 seconds of actual video playback (not just page load). Use a useEffect with a timer that tracks video.currentTime and calls the useRecordAdImpression mutation when the threshold is reached. Ensure the impression is recorded only once per session per video.
